name: PATCH /api/routing-rules/:id - Update a routing rule in place
description: Partially updates a routing rule. Answers 200 because it modifies an existing resource rather than creating one. ONLY the fields present in the body are written, so an operator correcting a typo in the name cannot accidentally clear the channel — the handler builds its SET list from present keys rather than using COALESCE, because COALESCE cannot express a deliberate NULL. ABSENCE AND NULL DIFFER: omitting source_channel leaves it untouched, while sending source_channel:null converts the rule into a catch-all that matches every channel, which is a meaningful value rather than a missing one. An empty body is rejected rather than treated as a silent no-op, because it is a caller mistake worth reporting. If assigned_user_id is supplied the handler verifies the user exists AND is active, mirroring the guard on assignment: a rule pointing at a departed colleague routes leads into a hole. QA: depends on register, login and a created rule.

testCases.name: Update every mutable field of the rule

errorCases.when: the body is empty, the id or assigned_user_id is not a UUID, name is blank or over 160 characters, source_channel is neither null nor one of the fourteen channels, criteria is over 255 characters, evaluation_order is not an integer between 0 and 100000, or is_active is not a boolean
the Authorization header is absent, or present without a Bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
no rule has that id, or a supplied assigned_user_id names no user
a supplied assigned_user_id names a deactivated user, who cannot be routed to
